library(tidyverse)

## Functions
Start small with Z score
```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if(!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have > 5 numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  
  return(z)
}
```

Does this actuall work?

```{r}
z_scores(x_vec)
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))
```

Don't run this

```{r eval = FALSE}
z_scores(iris)
z_scores("my name is")
z_scores(3)
```
